messages:
Maya (CSM): exported baseline adherence for Acadia Health — quick check before next week's renewal call. CSV attached. Main flag: 3 latency breaches in May for route /v1/generate, but uptime 99.97% over last 30d. cc @Priya for ops context.

Carlos (SLO Ops): saw the CSV, those latency p95 spikes align with scheduled maintenance windows on 2025-05-06 and 2025-05-20; we have traces. Might be eligible for credit? Need formal evidence bundle.

Priya (SRE): yep, maintenance windows were applied, but customer traffic peaked during the fallback window; attaching trace IDs and a quick uptime snippet:

```
period,uptime,latency_p50,latency_p95
2025-05-01_to_2025-05-31,99.97,45ms,720ms
```

Evan (AM): can we get a short one-pager explaining why an uptime credit may or may not apply? Customer wants clarity on renewal impact.

Maya (CSM): drafting a customer-facing note. Leaning against a full contract credit since aggregate SLA was met, but open to offering a one-time onboarding credit and an ops play to reduce p95 peaks. Will circulate draft.

Carlos (SLO Ops): recommend the evidence packet include: 1) timeline + affected request counts, 2) tracing spans (trace IDs), 3) whether fallback to small-model variant activated, and 4) mitigation actions (batching / cache warmup).

deploy-bot: Deployment 2025-05-06T03:12Z completed to prod (deploy id: d-8342). :white_check_mark:

Nora (Acadia): thanks for the heads-up team. We care most about p95 spikes — can you propose a targeted observability dashboard we can get read access to?

Priya (SRE): we can provision a read-only dashboard (Grafana) and add a pinned alert rule for p95 > 500ms. I'll create the dashboard and share the link + onboarding steps.

Maya (CSM): next steps: Priya to create dashboard + alert, Carlos to assemble evidence bundle (CSV + traces), I will draft the customer comms and proposed one-time credit amount. Target to have all by EOD Thursday. :spiral_calendar:

Evan (AM): I'll join the renewal call to walk through the note and mitigation plan. :thumbsup:

Maya (CSM): thanks all — will tag @legal for a quick review of the proposed credit language once draft is ready.
